args.title: Fix the password reset email link to point to the correct URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently generates a link using the BASE_URL set to 'http://localhost:3000', which causes the link to be unusable for users outside of the local environment. Update BASE_URL to use the production URL instead so that users can access the password reset page properly.
